description: Compatibility entry point for the individually exposed financial_evidence_funding_workflow, financial_evidence_institutions_workflow and financial_evidence_exit_workflow tools. Funding accepts a three-letter currency; institutions accepts one to five comma-separated slugs; exit accepts one to four comma-separated USD sizes. Empty selection uses the same published defaults. No additional operation is available. Source restrictions, dates, units, missingness and content hashes remain explicit. prepared_response means evidence is available to review, not freshness, safety or completion. No account or execution authority.
name: financial_evidence_workflow
